verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows platform-level Dashboard management, balance API calls, and payout scheduling for connected accounts — all requiring developer/ops involvement, not self-serve seller statements, reconciliation reports, or bookkeeper-ready exports. No mention of an Express-style seller dashboard, downloadable statements, or export tooling that would let sellers or their bookkeepers close the books without contacting the platform ops team. Missing for 10: seller-facing statement/export UI, reconciliation report generation, bookkeeper self-serve documentation.
